messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — SEV1: elevated 5xx rates for /v1/generate across hosted region us-east-1. Pager: sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): paging the SRE rotation now. I'm seeing partial 5xx spike and our dashboards are mostly empty — datadog metrics not updating since ~1832500800. :eyes:

matt (eng-sre): on it. Confirming: logs from the gateway are arriving in our log cluster, but Datadog ingestion shows delay/queueing. traces and metrics both impacted.

alex (eng-monitoring): i've checked the datadog agent fleet — agents show healthy, but dd-forwarder errors for api key ingestion. status.datadoghq.com shows "Ingestion Delays — US".

raj (eng-runtime): can we still see request/response rates in our local prometheus? we should fallback to internal dashboards if datadog is blind.

matt (eng-sre): prometheus has scrape data but dashboards aren't wired into runbook views. alex — can we flip the emergency prometheus -> grafana dashboard export?

alex (eng-monitoring): doing that now. Patch command:
```
./ops/scripts/enable_emergency_dashboards.sh --source prometheus --target grafana --ttl 2h
```
Should be live in ~2 mins.

jess (support): prepping a proactive customer notice — who is definitely impacted? Carmen, do you want support to hold until we know scope?

carmen (product): yes please. We have 3 enterprise tenants on dedicated capacity in us-east-1 with strict SLAs. If metrics/backfills are delayed >30m we need to start outreach.

matt (eng-sre): quick mitigation plan: 1) use prometheus fallback dashboards, 2) enable log-based alerts in our ELK for error rate, 3) route critical metrics directly to S3 via log shipper as a short-lived backup, 4) open a high-priority ticket with Datadog & request backfill.

raj (eng-runtime): i can toggle our shipper to S3. command:
```
kubectl -n infra set env ds/log-forwarder DD_BACKUP_S3=true DD_S3_BUCKET=redwood-incidents-backups
```
Will start putting critical metrics and gateway logs into S3 for offline analysis.

alex (eng-monitoring): started grafana import, dashboards populating. I also created a temporary alert rule in prometheus:
```
ALERT HostErrorRateHigh IF rate(http_requests_total{job=gw,code=~"5.."}[5m]) > 0.05
```
It will page SRE rotation if triggered.

inc-bot: @sara (oncall) — escalation: on-call rotation paged: matt -> raj next.

matt (eng-sre): FYI i opened ticket DD-INC-4872 with Datadog support, included request ids, sample traces, and timestamps. Datadog response: "Investigating ingestion issues in US-east. Some customers may see delayed metrics/logs. We will backfill after mitigation."

datadog-status-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Ingestion delays impacting US-east metrics and logs. Engineers are investigating.

sara (oncall): good. prioritizing customer impact: jess — please draft an initial message that says "observability delays affecting dashboards/alerts" and that we're using fallback systems. Do not call it a service outage — it's a vendor ingestion issue.

jess (support): drafting now. Proposed copy: "We're currently seeing delayed dashboard metrics due to a Datadog ingestion issue in us-east. Core request processing continues; we have enabled internal fallbacks and are collecting logs for post-incident analysis. We'll update within 30 minutes or when more info is available."

carmen (product): +1. Add note that enterprise tenants on dedicated capacity are being specially monitored and we'll offer a follow-up once Datadog backfill completes.

matt (eng-sre): in-parallel mitigation: reducing non-critical telemetry to lower dd ingestion load when they recover. alex — can you temporarily increase sampling to 1.0 for core paths only?

alex (eng-monitoring): done for /v1/generate and gateway error traces. command used:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MON_CFG' https://cfg.internal/api/sampling -d '{"path":"/v1/generate","sample":1.0}'
```

raj (eng-runtime): backup shipper started, logs + selected metrics now landing in s3 under prefix incidents/1832501023/. Pull script:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-incidents-backups/incidents/1832501023/ ./incident_dump --recursive
```

matt (eng-sre): note — because of Datadog blindspot some automatic runbook steps that rely on metric thresholds won't trigger. manual checks in progress.

inc-bot: Handoff due in 30m. Next on-call: raj (eng-runtime).

sara (oncall): handing off to raj. I’m going to step down after 15m for caffeine. @raj — i've left runbook notes and the ticket id in the incident doc.

raj (eng-runtime): taking over. quick summary: datadog ingestion delay in us-east, local prometheus available, shipper to s3 in place, dataplane healthy but increased 5xx. focusing on reducing error rates and ensuring customer comms.

datadog-status-bot: UPDATE: Root cause suspected — downstream ingestion queue saturation due to sudden customer load. Mitigation: throttling and backfill planned.

matt (eng-sre): spotted spike from a noisy client job. I've isolated IP and applied temporary throttling rule on the gateway:
```
iptables -I INPUT -s 203.0.113.45 -j DROP
```
Error rate dropped ~40% in the next 2 mins.

carmen (product): Good triage. Once stable, let's prepare SLA impact calc and any credits if backfill doesn't reconcile. jess keep the customer comms updated.

alex (eng-monitoring): Datadog just posted: "Ingestion delays mitigated — backfill in progress. Some dashboards will be updated as data arrives."

raj (eng-runtime): confirming: grafana + prometheus show error rate trending down. Backfill will take time. We should keep s3 dump until backfill confirmed.

jess (support): sent initial notice to affected customers. Will follow up if Datadog confirms full backfill or if we need to escalate.

matt (eng-sre): recommend we keep incident open as "obs blindspot" until Datadog confirms backfill complete + our SLO calculations verified.

sara (oncall): agree. i'll mark action items: (1) wait for datadog backfill confirmation, (2) verify alert thresholds and re-enable runbooks, (3) calculate impacted customers and SLA delta, (4) postmortem owner: matt.

inc-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING. Severity downgraded to SEV2 (observability degraded).

datadog-status-bot: FINAL UPDATE: Backfill complete for most customers in the US. Some delayed logs may still be ingested over next 24h.

raj (eng-runtime): closing notes: incident resolved from platform side; monitoring blindspot mitigated with prometheus fallback and S3 backup. Matt will lead postmortem. :white_check_mark:

matt (eng-sre): postmortem template created: link -> https://internal.redwood/inserts/postmortems/1832501023. I’ll include timeline, mitigation, and a recommended permanent fallback playbook (prometheus mirrors + pushgateway + s3 fallback).

jess (support): will follow up with customers tomorrow with a summary.

sara (oncall): thanks team. closing handoff to matt for postmortem work. :thumbsup:
